page_download_apple_silicon: Mac chip family (M1 and later), shown beside the size of the macOS download. Apple's own term, not translated.
page_download_badge_available: Badge on a download card for a platform that ships today.
page_download_chan_download: Button of a channel card: downloads the macOS .dmg of that channel. {label} is the channel name.
page_download_chan_meta: Small line of a channel card; the SHA-256 checksum follows it. {size} is the file size with its unit.
page_download_chan_none: Empty state of a channel card. {label} is the channel name.
page_download_channel_alpha_audience: Who the Alpha channel is for. Word for word audience of channels.json.
page_download_channel_alpha_promise: One-sentence promise of the Alpha channel. Word for word the promise of crates/atlas-core/data/channels.json (a site test fails when they drift).
page_download_channel_alpha_risk: Risk badge of the Alpha channel card. Word for word risk_label of channels.json.
page_download_channel_alpha_switch_to: What switching to the Alpha channel means. Word for word switch_to of channels.json.
page_download_channel_beta_audience: Who the Beta channel is for. Word for word audience of channels.json.
page_download_channel_beta_promise: One-sentence promise of the Beta channel. Word for word the promise of crates/atlas-core/data/channels.json (a site test fails when they drift).
page_download_channel_beta_risk: Risk badge of the Beta channel card. Word for word risk_label of channels.json.
page_download_channel_beta_switch_to: What switching to the Beta channel means. Word for word switch_to of channels.json.
page_download_channel_stable_audience: Who the Stable channel is for. Word for word audience of channels.json.
page_download_channel_stable_promise: One-sentence promise of the Stable channel. Word for word the promise of crates/atlas-core/data/channels.json (a site test fails when they drift).
page_download_channel_stable_risk: Risk badge of the Stable channel card. Word for word risk_label of channels.json.
page_download_channel_stable_switch_to: What switching to the Stable channel means. Word for word switch_to of channels.json.
page_download_channel_stage_alpha_note: Note shown while Atlas is in alpha. Word for word stage_note of channels.json.
page_download_channels_text: Intro of the Other channels section; {channel} (id) selects which channel the primary downloads are, {label} is its name, {macos} and {windows} are platform names passed by the page. Stable is the default after general availability; today the default is Alpha.
page_download_channels_title: Heading of the section with the Beta and Stable cards.
page_download_cli_next_linux: Line under the install command on the Linux card; the link goes to the Linux packages section of the installation docs.
page_download_cli_next_mac: Line under the install command on the macOS card; the link goes to the installation docs.

page_download_cli_next_windows.description: Line under the install command on the Windows card; the link goes to the Windows section of the installation docs.

page_download_cli_title: Heading above the install command on the macOS and Linux cards.
page_download_cli_title_powershell: Heading above the install command on the Windows card.
page_download_description: Meta description of the download page (search results, link previews). {macos} and {windows} are the platform names, passed by the page.
page_download_fact_date_latest: Text of the release date row while the date is not known.
page_download_fact_latest: Link text of the version row while the version number is not known: points to the latest release.
page_download_fact_license: Label of the license row in the release facts.
page_download_fact_license_value: The two licenses Atlas is offered under, as written in the release facts.
page_download_fact_notes: Label of the row with the links to the release notes.
page_download_fact_release_page: Link to the GitHub page of the release, in the release facts.
page_download_fact_released: Label of the release date row in the release facts.
page_download_fact_version: Label of the version row in the release facts.
page_download_h1: Main heading of the download page.
page_download_lead: Subtitle under the main heading of the download page. atlas is the command name, in code style.
page_download_lin_button: Button of the Linux card: opens the release page, where the packages are.
page_download_lin_meta: Small line beside the Linux button: an Arch Linux package exists as well.
page_download_lin_sub: Subtitle of the Linux card: architecture and the distributions it covers.
page_download_links_get: Short label of the download button in the hero and the closing section on phones (the long one is Download Atlas). i18n-distinct: the short label of the download button on phones, not the page heading.
page_download_links_star: Button that opens the GitHub repository so the visitor can star it, next to the download button.

page_download_mac_button.description: Button of the macOS card: downloads the .dmg disk image.

page_download_mac_intel_note.description: Note shown on the macOS card to a visitor whose Mac has an Intel chip. {cta} is the label of the notify button of the coming-soon cards.

page_download_mac_label: Subtitle of the macOS card with the latest version, for example Atlas 1.5.0-alpha.27 for Apple silicon.
page_download_mac_label_latest: Subtitle of the macOS card when the latest version could not be read: the button goes to the GitHub releases page.
page_download_mac_meta: Small line beside the macOS download button. {size} is the file size with its unit, for example 12.3 MB.
page_download_os_linux: Name of the Linux platform: card heading and requirements label on the download page.

page_download_os_macos.description: Name of the macOS platform: card heading and requirements label on the download page. A proper name, the same in every language.

page_download_os_windows.description: Name of the Windows platform: card heading and requirements label on the download page. A proper name, the same in every language.

page_download_phone_text: Text of the phone-visitor block of the download page, above the share and email buttons.
page_download_phone_title: Heading of the block shown only to phone visitors: Atlas does not run on a phone, so it offers to send the link.
page_download_primary_channel: Note above the release facts. {label} is the channel name (Alpha, Beta, Stable) and {promise} its one-sentence promise, from the channel copy of this page.
page_download_release_aria: Accessible name of the box with the version, date, notes and requirements.
page_download_req_optional: Optional tools: git and gh for worktrees and pull requests, Docker for the infra block of atlas.yaml. Tool names and the file name stay as written.
page_download_req_optional_label: Label of the requirements row that lists tools Atlas can use but does not need.
page_download_soon_linux_arm_name: Name of the coming-soon card for Linux on Arm computers.
page_download_soon_linux_arm_note: Description of the Linux on Arm coming-soon card: the package formats that will ship.

page_download_soon_macos_intel_name.description: Name of the coming-soon card for Macs with an Intel chip.

page_download_soon_macos_intel_note.description: Description of the Intel Mac coming-soon card.

page_download_soon_note: Note under the coming-soon cards. {windows} is the platform name passed by the page; the link goes to the build-from-source docs section.
page_download_soon_text: Text of the coming-soon section, above the platform cards with the notify forms.
page_download_soon_title: Heading of the coming-soon section and badge of each platform in it.

page_download_soon_windows_arm_name.description: Name of the coming-soon card for Windows PCs with an Arm chip. Microsoft's product designation, not translated.

page_download_soon_windows_arm_note.description: Description of the Windows on Arm coming-soon card.

page_download_terminals_note: Note about platform differences of Atlas Desktop. {macos} and {windows} are the platform names, passed by the page.
page_download_verify_text: Explains the SHA-256 checksums list. <file> is a placeholder the reader replaces with the file name; the commands stay as written.

page_download_win_button.description: Button of the Windows card: downloads the one-click installer.

page_download_win_meta: Small line beside the Windows download button. Atlas-Setup.exe is the file name.

page_download_win_smartscreen.description: Note on the Windows card while the installer is unsigned. The quoted warning and the two buttons are what Windows SmartScreen shows, so the pt-BR uses Windows' own Portuguese wording. policy links to the code signing policy page, sha to the checksums section.

page_download_win_sub.description: Subtitle of the Windows card: supported versions and that the installer needs no administrator rights.

page_download_you_linux: Label that marks the card of the visitor's own computer when it runs Linux.

page_download_you_mac.description: Label that marks the card of the visitor's own computer when it is a Mac.

page_download_you_pc: Label that marks the card of the visitor's own computer when it is a Windows PC.
